command:
set -euo pipefail
R=$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_grid_relay.py
echo SHA=$(sha256sum "$R" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 -m py_compile "$R"
for S in 'def verify_local_receipt' 'serialized_local_command' 'RECEIPT_COMMAND_DIGEST_MISMATCH' 'RECEIPT_TIMEOUT_NO_REPLAY' 'def return_to_omega'; do if grep -Fq "$S" "$R"; then echo "FEATURE_OK:$S"; else echo "FEATURE_MISSING:$S"; exit 41; fi; done
